# Deployment & Release Requirements Checklist: Deployment and Release Process

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of the deployment
and release requirements before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the required contents of a "complete production artifact" (client assets + server) fully enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the environment configuration keys the app requires explicitly identified rather than left generic? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for the ordering relationship between migration and app start in a release? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the set of dependencies a health check must cover (at minimum the database) specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for how the build/version identifier is produced and surfaced? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "reproducible" build quantified as an objectively checkable property (same source version → equivalent artifact, no manual steps)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "fail fast" defined with an observable outcome (non-zero exit, clear message before serving)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "safe to re-run" for migrations defined precisely (no duplicate or destructive change on an already-current schema)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "known-good release" defined clearly enough to identify a valid rollback target? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "healthy" defined as readiness (able to serve, dependencies reachable) rather than mere liveness? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Are the secret-handling requirements consistent between the build artifact (FR) and deploy-output logging (FR-012)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK012 Are the "no secrets in output" requirements consistent with the logging feature's (011) redaction guarantees? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK013 Do the rollback requirements align with the migration-safety requirements regarding non-backward-compatible changes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK014 Can "0 secrets in committed source or the artifact" be objectively verified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK015 Is "deploy to a fresh environment with no undocumented steps" expressed as a verifiable outcome? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the health-check success criterion stated so healthy/unhealthy conditions are objectively distinguishable? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK017 Is "each release maps back to its exact source version" verifiable from the release artifact/output? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements defined for a missing/invalid required configuration value at startup? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements defined for a migration failure mid-release (halt vs proceed)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined for a deployment whose dependency (database) is unreachable at verification time? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for rolling back when the latest migration is not backward-compatible? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the behavior specified for building an artifact when a build input is missing or the tree is dirty? [Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK023 Are expectations for startup-validation and health-check responsiveness stated or bounded? [Non-Functional, Gap]
- [ ] CHK024 Are the requirements platform-agnostic (no single hosting provider assumed) as intended? [Non-Functional, Spec §Assumptions]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK025 Is the reuse of existing build and migration tooling documented as an assumption? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the dependency of optional CI-triggered automation on feature 008 documented? [Dependency, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK027 Are out-of-scope items (zero-downtime, blue/green, scaling, infra provisioning, alerting) explicitly recorded? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK028 Is there any ambiguity between the container-image artifact path and the existing Replit build/start path regarding "the" reproducible artifact? [Ambiguity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the documentation requirement (build, config, migrate, deploy, verify, rollback) specific enough to be validated against actual behavior? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Focus areas: release safety (migrations/rollback), configuration & secrets, and health verification
- Depth: Standard | Audience: Reviewer (PR)
